name: @myavenceo/aven-brands

scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website dev
scripts.check: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website check
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd brands/CEO/design-system build && bun run brand:generate
scripts.build:next: bun run build:packages && PUBLIC_ID_BASE_URL=https://id.next.aven.ceo bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website build && bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website audit:build next
scripts.build:production: bun run build:packages && PUBLIC_ID_BASE_URL=https://id.aven.ceo bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website build && bun run --cwd brands/CEO/apps/website audit:build production
scripts.dev:yma: bun run build:packages:yma && bun run --cwd brands/YMA/apps/website dev
scripts.build:yma: bun run build:packages:yma && bun run --cwd brands/YMA/apps/website build
scripts.build:packages:yma: bun run --cwd brands/YMA/design-system build && bun run --cwd brands/YMA/apps/website brand:generate

description: Every brand the company renders, and the one kit that renders them.
